item.title: About Blacksburg
item.description:
Blacksburg sits in the New River Valley of Southwest Virginia, where the energy of Virginia Tech meets the quieter pleasures of a mountain-town visit. A day here can be as full or unhurried as you like: walk a campus path, browse downtown, catch a performance, or head out for fresh air.

A town shaped by place

Virginia Tech is part of the rhythm of Blacksburg. The campus draws students, families, alumni, researchers, and visitors from around the world, while downtown brings people together over food, shops, and community life. Beyond town, the landscape opens into wooded trails, ridgelines, and the wider New River Valley.

Make an event part of your itinerary

  • Before you go: Confirm the date, start time, venue address, tickets, age guidance, and accessibility information with the organizer.
  • Plan the trip: Check parking, arrival instructions, and local transportation options before event day.
  • Book early: Major university events can affect lodging availability and restaurant wait times.
  • Leave a little room: Add time for traffic, finding your seat, and a meal before or after.
Schedules change

Always confirm with the organizer

Event dates, ticket availability, venues, and entry details can change. The linked calendars are the best place to check current information; verify the final details directly before traveling.

No event on your dates?

Blacksburg still makes a good day out. Explore campus, downtown, and nearby trails, find a place for dinner on the dining guide, or plan an easy-going weekend in town.

Follow your appetite

  • Coffee and breakfast: Start near downtown or campus, then check whether the kitchen opens early enough for your plans.

Make dining part of the route

Pair a downtown meal with a walk through local shops, grab a bite between campus activities, or plan dinner after the Huckleberry Trail. Search the map above to compare locations and routes.

item.title: Plan Your Visit
item.description:
Make the most of your time in Blacksburg. Combine Virginia Tech, downtown, local food, and the New River Valley’s outdoor spaces at a pace that feels right for you.

Get oriented

Search for an address, business, or attraction and open the results in Google Maps. Start with a few visitor favorites:

Start downtown Shops, cafés & local flavor Get your bearings around downtown Blacksburg and make a meal part of the stroll. Explore → Hokie country Virginia Tech campus Plan a campus visit and check visitor parking information before you arrive. Explore → Find your fresh air Huckleberry Trail Look up trail access and maps for this paved connection between Blacksburg and Christiansburg. Explore →

Itinerary ideas

A day in Blacksburg

  1. Start downtown. Grab breakfast or coffee and explore the area around Main Street.
  2. Make time for campus. Walk through Virginia Tech and check its visitor guide for tours, highlights, and parking.
  3. Take a lunch break. Choose a place downtown or near your next stop.
  4. Get outside. Walk or bike a section of the Huckleberry Trail, checking current access and conditions first.
  5. Leave the evening open. Find dinner, a performance, or a game if one is on the calendar.

A weekend in the New River Valley

Day one: Get oriented downtown, explore Virginia Tech, and settle in for a local dinner. If an event is on the calendar, give yourself time for it.

Take campus at your own pace

item.title: Where to Stay
item.description:

Find a convenient home base

Near the action Search around campus Compare lodging locations near Virginia Tech and confirm the route, parking, and event-day access. Explore → Walkable plans Stay near downtown Look for a base that makes it easy to enjoy downtown restaurants and shops. Explore → Room to roam Explore the region Compare options around the New River Valley if your plans stretch beyond town. Explore →

Before you reserve

  • Check the exact address and how long it takes to reach the places on your itinerary.
  • Confirm parking availability, fees, and any event-day restrictions.
  • Review check-in times, cancellation terms, deposits, and included amenities.
  • Ask directly about accessibility features, pet policies, and room needs important to your group.
  • Book early for Virginia Tech games, commencement, family weekends, and other high-demand dates.
Busy dates

Let the event calendar guide your timing

University events can affect room availability and prices. Check the Virginia Tech calendar before choosing dates, and contact the lodging provider to confirm current rates and policies.

Build your stay around the trip

See what to do on campus and outdoors in our things-to-do guide, find your next meal on the dining page, and use the visitor planner to connect the dots.
